function.name: classify_ticket
function.description: Emit the ticket intent, disposition, and whether to escalate. Not the customer-facing email.

intent.description: Two to six words naming what the customer wants, e.g. "reset password", "refund request", "MX not verifying".

disposition.description: answer = an ordinary how-to or account question about the product; escalate = a human must act (policy, billing, legal, anger); unanswerable = not about the product, or spam.

escalate.description: true when a human should see this thread even if an answer was drafted.
